ENGINE and DRIvETRAIN
Which BRZ is yours?
Engine 2.0-liter DOHC aluminum-alloy 16-valve 4-cylinder horizontally opposed SUBARU BOXER® engine with

BRZ Premium BRZ Limited Torque 151 lb-ft @ 6,400 rpm

TRACTION and STABILITy

s Additions or differences from preceding trim level. Front and rear stabilizer bars.

Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD).
Brake discs (front/rear) 11.6 inches/11.4 inches
Brake Assist When emergency braking is detected by how quickly the brake pedal is pressed, maximum brake pressure is immediately applied.
Brake Override System If both brake and accelerator pedals are pressed simultaneously, the system reduces the operation of the accelerator pedal to help
prevent unintentional vehicle acceleration.
WHEELS and TIRES
Wheels 17 x 7.0-inch machined-finish and dark gray multi-spoke aluminum-alloy
Tires 215/45 R17 summer-performance

Length/Width/Height 166.7 inches/69.9 inches (including mirrors: 77.8 inches)/50.6 inches

Protecting Your Investment Shoulder room (front/rear) 54.5 inches/51.7 inches
